messages:
Lina: dropped a compact mock for the trace viewer header — figma: https://www.figma.com/file/def/compact-trace-header
Lina: goals: reduce header noise, collapse long correlation ids, single primary action 'Download snapshot' that defaults to JSON, kebab for additional formats
Jose: I like collapsing long IDs. Suggest showing first 10 chars + copy button. Hover reveals full id and copy feedback.
Erin: Copy debate: 'Download snapshot' vs 'Save capture' vs 'Export trace' — my bias is 'Download snapshot' since support folks understand 'download' better.
Tom: infra note: when including KV cache bundle size can spike. Recommend we show an estimated size and span count before starting generation. queue big jobs and return signed URL (ttl 10m). infra-bot: logged as #infra-ticket-442
a11y-bot: auto-check: estimate-chip contrast 2.8:1 on 1951240012. Needs >=4.5:1 for small text. Also recommend aria-live for dynamic size updates.
Lina: updated mock: size chip now bolder and darker bg, aria-live="polite" on the chip, chip reads like: '~ 3.1 MB · 1,022 spans'
Jose: keyboard flow: Search -> Filters -> CTA -> Kebab. Make sure CTA has aria-label including trace id e.g. aria-label="Download snapshot for trace 0x9f3"
Erin: tooltip language: CTA tooltip = 'Quick snapshot (JSON). Use menu for HAR or full bundle)'. Kebab menu items: 'Download as HAR', 'Download full bundle (incl. KV)'
Tom: backend: endpoint to kick job returns {job_id, estimated_size, span_count}. We'll add rate-limit and background worker. toast link -> signed url valid 600s.
Lina: micro-interaction: when job completes show persistent toast: 'Snapshot ready — Download · Copy link'. Provide keyboard hint: 'Press D then L to download / copy link'
Jose: permission gating: only users with trace:download role see CTA. Others see disabled button with tooltip 'Request access' and link to modal.
Erin: accessibility edgecases: if filters change while size is calculating, aria-live should announce 'Estimate updated: ~ 2.9 MB · 980 spans'. Also ensure toast focusable, focus returns to triggering element when dismissed.
Tom: telemetry: events = trace_snapshot_click, export_menu_select, export_job_completed (include span_count + estimated_size).
Lina: decision summary: primary copy 'Download snapshot' (JSON default), kebab for HAR/full bundle, show estimated size + span count with aria-live, collapse correlation id with copy affordance + pin option, permission gating for exports, contrast fix for size chip, background job + signed url infra. Lina -> will update figma and add a11y checklist.
Erin: can we do a quick 5-person usability run next Tue focusing on 'Download snapshot' wording? I want to validate non-dev comprehension.
Lina: added to calendar. Thanks all! :party_poppers:
